s.n: Letter Q quince and cheddar quesadillas
s.note: Quince paste and sharp cheddar in crisp tortillas, a food starting with Q.
s.how: Scatter half of each tortilla with cheddar, quince and onion, then fold over. Toast in a buttered pan over medium heat until golden and the cheese melts. Cut into wedges and serve with rocket and lime.

s.n: Cat in an oven buttermilk biscuits
s.note: Flaky buttermilk biscuits with honey butter. Sidney explains what makes a biscuit.
s.how: Rub the cold butter into the flour, baking powder and salt until it looks like rough crumbs. Stir in the buttermilk, pat out 3cm thick, fold twice and cut 8 rounds. Bake close together at 220C until tall and golden. Beat the soft butter with the honey and a pinch of salt and serve with the hot biscuits.
shop: 100g cold butter, diced, plus 60g soft for the honey butter@Dairy

m.note: Charred skirt steak tacos with salsa verde, played like you can't play.
m.how: Rub the steak with the lime juice, garlic, cumin, oil and salt and leave at least 30 minutes. Grill on a very hot pan 3 minutes a side, then rest and slice thinly across the grain. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with steak, salsa verde, onion and coriander.

m.note: Pork and beef meatballs in red sauce on a hero roll.
m.how: Mix both minces with the breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt, and roll into 16 balls. Brown the meatballs in the oil, then add the passata, oregano and remaining garlic. Simmer gently until cooked through and the sauce is thick. Fill the split rolls with meatballs and sauce, top with mozzarella and grill until melted.

w.n: Slam dunk churros with hot chocolate
w.note: Cinnamon sugar churros with thick chocolate. Billy bets he can dunk.
w.how: Bring the water, butter and 1 tbsp sugar to the boil, beat in the flour until it forms a ball, then beat in the eggs one at a time. Pipe 10cm lengths into oil at 180C and fry until deep gold. Roll the hot churros in the cinnamon and sugar. Heat the milk with the cornflour and whisk in the chocolate until thick, then serve for dunking.
shop: 1 tbsp caster sugar, plus 100g for coating@Pantry

d.note: Watermelon blended with lime and mint over ice. Gloria wants sympathy not a glass of water.
d.how: Blend the watermelon with the lime juice, sugar, water and half the mint until smooth. Strain into a jug and chill. Pour over ice with the rest of the mint.
